units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 30:32">Targ. O. Gen. XXX, 32</cite> (h. text <he>טלוא</he>).—Pl. <he>רְקוֹעִין</he>, <he>רְקוֹעַיָּא</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 118b:4">B. Kam. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>בר׳</he> in the case of the theft of a spotted sheep (the presence of which, if returned, I must be noticed).—Pl. <he>רְקוֹעָתָא</he>. Targ. O. l. c. 35.

senses.gloss: (trnsf., v. B. Kam. l. c.) well-known, distinguished.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:18">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מאן חשיב</he> … <he>מאן ר׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="T01031"><he>רַקִּיעַ</he></cite>) who is esteemed, who is I regarded, who is distinguished (before the angel of death)?
